capabilities: Track habits per day with statuses completed, failed, skipped and not started
Render habit tables as heatmap-style grids in day, week or month cadences
Store habit entries in the frontmatter of notes in a chosen folder
Schedule habits by weekday and edit their schedule property
Select multiple entries with shift-click or keyboard and change their status in bulk
extras: Includes developer documentation for running the table code in a browser without Obsidian, plus tests and release tooling.
intentEvidence: an extension that I found so useful it motivated me to build my own
motivation: The author credits zincplusplus for the original idea and says an extension was so useful it motivated him to build his own.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track daily habits with statuses like completed, failed or skipped inside notes.

relations.evidence: Special thanks to zincplusplus for the original idea, and an extension

summary: Habit tracker that renders heatmap-style calendar tables from code blocks and stores habit entries in note frontmatter.
